title: Export orders as CSV
notes: Synthetic change to the demo shop with seeded defects.

defects.summary: Amounts lose trailing zeros: 1250 cents is written as 12.5.
defects.caught_if: a condition exports an amount ending in zero cents and checks two decimals
defects.observed: an order paid 1250 cents exported as '1,12.5,pen'

defects.summary: Item names are joined with ';', so a name containing ';' cannot be told apart from two items.
defects.caught_if: a condition exports an item name containing a semicolon and checks it is read back as one item
defects.observed: item 'pens; blue' exported as 'pens; blue', indistinguishable from two items
